sunday: It's Sunday. Calories don't count today. 🥞
Sunday: The day to do absolutely nothing without guilt. 🛋️
A Sunday well spent brings a week of content. 🌿
Warning: Sunday mode activated. Proceed with extreme laziness. 🦥
Sunday reset. Breathe out the week, breathe in the calm. 🧘‍♀️
memes: I'm not saying I'm Wonder Woman, I'm just saying no one has ever seen me and Wonder Woman in the same room. 🦸‍♀️
My favorite exercise is a cross between a lunge and a crunch... I call it lunch. 🍔
I need a 6-month vacation, twice a year. ✈️
My vibe right now is just drinking water and minding my own business. 🚰
I finally got my winter body ready. Wait, it's summer? 🏖️
I whispered to my Wi-Fi, 'I love you.' It replied, 'Connection lost.' 📶
Does running out of patience count as cardio? 🏃‍♀️
I'm on a seafood diet. I see food and I eat it. 🍕
Of course I talk to myself. Sometimes I need expert advice. 👩‍🏫
I tried to be normal once. Worst two minutes of my life. 🙃
general: Your body is not broken — it is asking to be understood.
Tracking is an act of radical self-care.
You do not need to earn rest. Rest is part of healing.
Be gentle with yourself. You are doing the best you can.
Knowledge about your body is power. You are getting there.
Small steps in health add up to something beautiful.
Consistency beats perfection, every single time.
Today is a good day to show yourself some grace.
Understanding yourself is the beginning of everything.
Your body works hard for you every single day.
No guilt, no shame — just data and compassion.
Progress over perfection, always.
Some days you log, some days you rest. Both are valid.
Honoring your body means listening when it asks for rest.
Your wellness is a priority, not an afterthought.
A slower pace is sometimes the most productive choice.
Give yourself permission to pause.
Nourish your body and mind gently today.
Breathe deeply. You are doing fine.
Celebrate your small victories today.
Healing is not linear, and that is okay.
Take it one day, one step, one breath at a time.
"The most effective way to do it, is to do it." — Amelia Earhart
"Caring for myself is not self-indulgence, it is self-preservation." — Audre Lorde
"Nothing can dim the light which shines from within." — Maya Angelou
"Owning our story and loving ourselves through that process is the bravest thing that we'll ever do." — Brené Brown
"Almost everything will work again if you unplug it for a few minutes, including you." — Anne Lamott
